definitions.name: O2B.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DN DD O2B.MOD 0 GT NOT ] FILTER

definitions.name: O2B.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'CE' BIND 'CV' BIND 1 CV 3 MUL 1 ADD CV 2 DIV CV 2 O2B.MOD 0 GT SELECT CV 1 EQ SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN step (acc elem): next Collatz value of acc, staying at 1; elem ignored

definitions.name: O2B.GSUM
definitions.body: 'GV' BIND 'GK' BIND GK GV GROUP 'GG' BIND GG KEYS GG VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of keys, Vector of numbers to Record key -> sum of its numbers, keys in first-appearance order

definitions.name: O2B.LINE
definitions.body: 'OL' BIND OL 'price' GET 'PP' BIND 0 OL 'qty' GET PP MUL PP NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: order Record to qty times price, or 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: O2B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when even)

definitions.name: O2B.DEV
definitions.note: Vector of numbers to each number minus the mean
